Description
The 1 oz Johnson Matthey Gold Bar is a premier choice for investors and collectors seeking to add high-quality gold bullion to their portfolios. Crafted from .9999 fine gold (24-karat), these bars represent one of the purest forms of gold available on the market.
Design
Each gold bar features a simple yet elegant design:
Obverse: Showcases the Johnson Matthey (JM) logo and coat of arms, along with inscriptions of the weight (“1 oz”), purity (“.9999”), and unique serial number.
Reverse: May display a repeating JM pattern or be left blank, depending on the production year.
The bars have a clean, stamped finish, distinguishing them from engraved surfaces, and offer a modern, sleek appearance that appeals to both investors and collectors.
Packaging and Security
Tamper Evident Packaging (TEP): Each bar is securely encased in TEP, which provides an additional layer of protection and reveals any signs of tampering. This ensures the bar remains in its original condition.
Certification: The outer packaging includes the bar’s serial number and certificate details, matching the information stamped on the bar itself.
Product Specifications
Manufacturer: Johnson Matthey
Weight: 1 Troy Ounce (31.10 grams)
Purity: .9999 Fine Gold
Thickness: 2 mm
Dimensions: 50.5 mm x 30 mm
Metal Content: Gold
Year of Production: Random
Key Features
Contains 1 troy ounce of .9999 fine gold.
Produced by the reputable Johnson Matthey Mint, renowned for quality and craftsmanship.
TEP Packaging ensures security and authenticity, displaying any evidence of tampering.
Widely recognized and trusted in the global precious metals market.
Ideal for portfolio diversification and as a hedge against economic uncertainties.
Excellent gift option due to its intrinsic value and universal appeal.
Why Choose the 1 oz Johnson Matthey Gold Bar?
Investing in the 1 oz Johnson Matthey Gold Bar offers several advantages:
Purity and Quality: With a purity of .9999 fine gold, you are acquiring one of the purest gold bars available.
Liquidity: Johnson Matthey bars are globally recognized, making them easy to buy, sell, or trade anywhere in the world.
Security: The inclusion of TEP packaging and unique serial numbers provides confidence in the authenticity and integrity of your investment.
Affordability: Smaller bars like the 1 oz size offer a more accessible entry point into gold investing.
Investment Benefits
Gold has long been considered a safe-haven asset, retaining its value over time and providing a hedge against inflation and currency fluctuations. Adding the 1 oz Johnson Matthey Gold Bar to your investment portfolio can:
Diversify Assets: Reduce risk by spreading investments across different asset classes.
Protect Wealth: Preserve purchasing power during economic downturns.
Enhance Liquidity: Easily convert to cash when needed due to high market demand.
Ordering Information
Enhance your investment portfolio or collection today by purchasing the 1 oz Johnson Matthey Gold Bar. Each bar is shipped promptly and discreetly, ensuring a secure and satisfactory transaction.
Note: The bars are offered from random production years based on availability. Designs may vary slightly depending on the year of minting.
